LESSON: KUSOMA 9.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFAHAMU KIFUNGU CHA KUSHAWISHI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MATUMIZI YA VIFAA VYA KIDIJITALI KATIKA BIASHARA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum 
Topic 9.2: Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kushawishi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kushawishi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kudondoa habari mahususi katika kifungu cha kushawishi
2. kueleza maana za maneno kama yalivyotumiwa katika kifungu cha kushawishi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kudondoa habari mahususi katika kifungu cha kushawishi
   In simple words: practise until you can kudondoa habari mahususi katika kifungu cha kushawishi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kueleza maana za maneno kama yalivyotumiwa katika kifungu cha kushawishi
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana za maneno kama yalivyotumiwa katika kifungu cha kushawishi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kushawishi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kushawishi in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kushawishi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kushawishi.
4. Show that you can: kudondoa habari mahususi katika kifungu cha kushawishi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kushawishi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kushawishi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kudondoa habari mahususi katika kifungu cha kushawishi
2. kueleza maana za maneno kama yalivyotumiwa katika kifungu cha kushawishi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
